answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 21763 Country: United Kingdom Title: Last Night in my dream.. well it was morning time actually, I had a dream that i was on the phone to my fiancee and i was reciting namaaz to him.. first i read subhanakallah humma ect.. then i read alhamdulilahhe rabbil alameen ect.. then i recited atthahiyato lilahi wasalwato ect.. then i read rabig alini mukimasalati ect.. then i said to him i am a little confused on this bit.. after that i saw myself reading full namaaz and then whilst making dua, i was saying sorry to Allah(swt) for not reading namaaz earlier. Please note... this was morning time, then i woke up. Please tell me the meaning to my dream a.s.a.p.. i have also had the same kind of dream before too. Once I saw myself reading alhamdulilahi ect.. and the next time i saw myself doing sajhda and bowing my head down to allah for respect. Question: Asalamualaikum Wa Rakhmatullahi Wa Barakatuhu.. Please note... this was morning time, then i woke up. Please tell me the meaning to my dream a.s.a.p.. i have also had the same kind of dream before too. Once I saw myself reading alhamdulilahi ect.. and the next time i saw myself doing sajhda and bowing my head down to allah for respect. Jazakallah Khairan Wasalamu Alaikum Wa Rakhmatullahi Wa Barakatuhu Answer ID: 21763 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 972/734/H=1431) Ma-shaAllah, it is nice dream. It means that you should get married if there is no hindrance as soon as possible. In-sha-Allah this nikah will cause khushu and khuzu (fear of God and humility) in your prayers. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
